**Repaired scraper configuration (YAML)**  

```yaml
scraper:
  url_pattern: "^https://example\\.test/gpu-1$"

  schema: "gpu-price-schema-v1"

  selectors:
    product_id:
      path: "//div[@id='product']/@data-product-id"
      type: "text"

    title:
      path: "//h1[@class='product-title']/text()"
      type: "text"

    brand:
      # Brand was previously omitted – added from the meta tag
      path: "//meta[@property='og:brand']/@content"
      type: "text"

    price:
      path: "//span[@class='price-current']/text()"
      type: "currency"

    original_price:
      # Extracting the original price if it exists on the page (sale)
      path: "//span[@class='price-original']/text()"
      type: "currency"
      optional: true

    availability:
      # Updated selector – the site now uses a data‑attribute
      path: "//div[@id='product']/@data-availability"
      type: "text"

    rating:
      path: "//span[@class='rating-value']/text()"
      type: "float"

    review_count:
      # New selector for number of reviews
      path: "//span[@class='reviews-count']/text()"
      type: "int"
      optional: true

    description:
      # Previously the scraper skipped the description paragraph
      path: "//div[@class='product-desc']/p/text()"
      type: "text"

    specs:
      # Extract all spec rows from the specs table
      path: "//table[@id='specs']//tr"
      type: "table"
      headers:
        - "Specification"
        - "Value"
      optional: true

    image_url:
      # Updated to fetch the big‑image src
      path: "//img[@id='main-image']/@src"
      type: "url"

    url:
      # Preserve the page URL as "canonical" if provided
      path: "//link[@rel='canonical']/@href"
      type: "url"
      default: "@@current_url"

  output:
    # Ensure the output follows the expected schema
    format: "json"
```

**Explanation of changes**

* Added missing fields required by **gpu-price-schema-v1** – `brand`, `original_price`, `review_count`, `description`, `specs`, and `image_url`.  
* Updated the `availability` selector to use the new data‑attribute that the site now employs.  
* Included optional flags for fields that may not appear on all pages.  
* Simplified the `url` selector to pull the canonical URL when present, falling back to the current page URL.  
* Stated the output format as `json` to match the schema's expectation. The rest of the existing selectors remain unchanged.
